exterior: 临街开敞拱与两侧山墙
local_metric_axes: E=(lon-originLon) × 111320 cos(originLat), N=(lat-originLat) × 110882, Z above street surface in metres.
image_coordinates: 1000×690 pixels, origin top-left; centered rectilinear horizontal field 100°; pitch 18° upward. Azimuth true north clockwise. Source metadata position uses inverse provider projection.
method: Point-to-ray least squares initializes 3D labels. Joint reprojection loss is soft-L1 with 2.8px scale and 1.5 robustness scale. Camera centers and orientations retained as soft priors (0.85m horizontal, 0.28m vertical, 2.5° per rotation-vector component). The six correction values are east, north, up metres, then three right-handed rotation-vector degrees in world ENU; corrected world-to-camera basis equals original basis times rotvec matrix. Each year is also independently solved. No building-size, ground-footprint or symmetry prior was applied.
limitations: 三角点的重复纹理、近处枝条或窗篷会偏移拱肩读数。高处折点以可辨屋瓦折线作近似。
独立年解共享同一调查者的形态辨认和供应商轨迹系统。分年吻合不等于绝对测量精度。
道路与宅基面可能有高差。楼内与背墙形状未从本组街景得出。
